knowledge.purpose: Holds the place of a block, capability, connector, pattern or icon the app needs but the catalogue does not carry yet, until a generator or a marketplace install fills it
useCases: A block need the composer could not meet from installed packs
A section that waits on a capability or connector the app has not installed
Keeping a page's layout honest while a missing piece is ordered
antiPatterns: An empty image slot — media.image keeps its own layout with an empty or placeholder src
Empty-state messaging — use the empty-state pattern
A tile the author could fill today with an installed block
knowledge.implementation: Themeable tile (card ground, dashed border) at least minHeight tall (120px default), full width. Editor: the label plus 'Still to come — <kind> · <need>'. Live: the same ground and nothing else — no text, no call to action, aria-hidden. Root carries data-block-type="placeholder", data-pw-need="<need>" and data-pw-need-kind="<kind>" so the canvas and gates find the unmet need.

props.name: label
props.description: A short human name for what will stand here, e.g. 'Booking calendar'. Shown in the editor only; the live tile carries no text.

props.name: need
props.description: The need key the composer recorded for this unmet need; exposed as data-pw-need.

props.name: kind
props.description: What kind of atom the need asks for.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height of the tile (number = px, or any CSS length). Match the size of what will replace it so the layout does not jump. Default 120px.
